questions.question_text: Explain the working of Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN).

value_points.text: GAN (Generative Adversarial Networks) suitable for image enhancement/generation
GAN has two parts: Generator & Discriminator
Generator takes noise and generates fake data, Discriminator identifies real (1) or fake (0)

questions.question_text: Explain the role of LSTM and CNN in image captioning models.

value_points.text: LSTM (Long Short Term Memory) used for sequential data and captioning
CNN used for image based data and feature extraction
Forget gate decides necessary content while storing past memory
